BL-1156.author: Claude (sprint 48, NR-962 ruled B, 2026-10-01)
BL-1156.title: A river divides its banks: the province fill pays to cross a course, not to travel along it
BL-1156.design: SETTLED (Ben, 2026-10-01, NR-962 B): PROVINCES.md, 'a river divides its banks'. Today the river bit sits on the step between a course tile and its downstream neighbour (river_generation.cpp ~223-230) and province.cpp ~212-213 charges +40 there, so the fill pays to travel along a river and crosses bank to bank free. BUILD: the fill pays the river cost to step onto or off a course across the flow (or an equivalent that makes the banks two sides); stepping along a course pays nothing extra. MEASURE FIRST, then after, on the 16 shipped seeds: the river:plain border ratio (1.19 on main), C13's per-seed river rows (red on 12, 37, 38), province counts and sizes. A row: river cost 0 must turn the river row red on the harness world AND the shipped seeds.

BL-1159.author: Claude (sprint 48, the BL-1137 gate on main, 2026-10-03)
BL-1159.title: The Highway tier is read on the shipped worlds, and its harness row asks the world the player gets
BL-1159.design:
RULED (Ben, 2026-10-03): the Road cliff is accepted as the rule -- a tied pre-industrial block keeps its midpoint rank, and where it falls under 0.40 its roads stay Track. Haulage read before merge.

RULED (Ben, 2026-10-03): qualification reads the polity's own industrial crossing year (q.industrial_year) on a generated world; measured first. POPULATION.md § Qualification.

MEASURED (2026-10-03, 5aa6b7a9 + ea03e90e merged): shipped worlds carry Highway tiles only from the ancient-corridor works rule; the national rule qualifies 0 links on all 16 seeds, because every nation's qualification reads region::industrialised, which a generated world never sets (history_sim.cpp ~9080), so all tie at 0.05 (percentile 0.5, the all-tied shape). 13-37 nations a seed hold two or more City+; 35-179 City-City links laid. R2s-b red, put to Ben.

FOUND 2026-10-03: road_generation_harness R2 ("highway tier reachable") is red on main a83e6188 and has been since BL-1141. It builds no_prehistory worlds, which run no industrial urbanisation, so a nation holds at most one City+ and a Highway (two City+ centres in one nation) never qualifies. The shipped worlds now carry ~2,700 cities pooled (BL-1137 at x4 jobs), so they may well carry Highways. WORK: read Highway tiles and City-City links per curated seed on the shipped path; move R2 to (or add) a shipped-world reading; if shipped worlds still lay no Highway, report why for Ben. Never weaken R2 to pass.

BL-1171.author: Claude (Ben's Exploration trade form, 2026-10-03)
BL-1171.title: In the Exploration age far realms across water meet and bind where a fleet reaches, and goods between landmasses must sail
BL-1171.design:
RULED (Ben, 2026-10-03, after B'+C flooded -- 79 -> 550 lanes at 1660, four seeds 52-150): the seller binds a far partner only where its fleet OUT-PROJECTS the partner's own fleet at the partner's port (judge_crossing's defender comparison); goods between landmasses sail in BOTH spans. Switches committed off at f9de3283 on the lane branch. Measure first; if it still floods or starves, report.

SETTLED (Ben, 2026-10-03): EXPLORATION.md § The colonial tie is a sea lane (overturning NR-888 for Exploration). B': far pairs across water meet AND bind in Exploration only where the seller's fleet reaches the partner's port (fleet_power_at, halving over 10 sea tiles) -- navies set the count, not a dial. C: a road carries goods only between seats on one landmass; cross-landmass trade must sail. Baseline (16 seeds, 1660): 79 lanes (12 trade); 87 cross-landmass pairs in contact, 75 bound; 86% of cross-landmass trade by road. MEASURE FIRST, then build; report 1660/1960 lanes by writer and length, far pairs bound, battles, and trade lost for pairs with no navy or port.

BL-1172.author: Claude (Ben's firm survival form, 2026-10-03)
BL-1172.title: An army eats what its owner can buy at a fair price: above it the unit draws less and fights weaker
BL-1172.design: SETTLED (Ben, 2026-10-03): FINANCE.md § Standing-force upkeep. BL-1164 diagnosis (firm_attrition_trace): upkeep goods paid at resolved price (rations ~48 vs base 13.6, ordnance ~925 vs 155.8), ~970/yr a unit vs hire ~120; 73/91 rivals wound up by tick 40 on seed 0. BUILD (measured first): the unit draw buys up to the reservation price only (BL-654's ceiling, re-read: is it set at a fair multiple of base?), and a short-fed unit draws less and fights weaker (strength scaled by its supply share). Read firm_attrition_trace (corps alive at 12/40/100/450, exits by cause), spawn_solvency, battles in play.

BL-1182.author: Claude (Ben's between-rounds lens request, 2026-10-04)
BL-1182.title: Resource lens: washed-clear map, toggled set of up to six extractable goods, split tiles, search-and-checklist key
BL-1182.design: SETTLED (Ben, 2026-10-04 form): LENSES.md § Resource lens. Non-deposit ground washes toward white (land off-white, water pale blue-grey) and the activity fog is lifted under the lens. The lens draws a toggled SET (ui_state.lens_resources, max 6, extractable only, listed only if present on the body); a tile with 2+ toggled goods splits into equal pie wedges from the centre in toggle order. The key is a search box over a checklist. Hover/press resolve to the wedge under the pointer; the hover highlight lights by membership. Market/Scarcity keep the single shared combo (lens_resource).
